identity.name: Yonhap News Agency
identity.description: South Korea's major national news agency, supplying domestic and international news to Korean and overseas media.

ownership.ownershipNotes: A cooperative news agency owned by South Korean newspapers and broadcasters, with a public-service role in national news distribution. It is not a government agency.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Cooperative structure and wire-service mandate; coverage is generally factual and institution-focused.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Right-Center and Mostly Factual; South Korean establishment sources and security framing.

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage follows South Korea's export-corporate model and market framing.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames North Korea and regional security through the South Korean alliance perspective.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting Mostly Factual and credibility High; national wire with broad sourcing.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Right-Center; factual reporting Mostly Factual; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: South Korean national-wire voice. Provides fast, factual coverage of Korean politics, business and North Korea, framed through Seoul's alliance and security perspective.

selectionRationale: Provides essential Korean-language-origin news in English and fast national wire coverage, already active.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Cooperative ownership distinguishes Yonhap from state media. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
